# Third-party code

| Component | Version | License | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| [MinHook](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook) | 1.3.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`minhook/LICENSE.txt`) | Function hooking |
| [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) | 3.12.0 | MIT (`nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT`) | Config parsing |

Both licenses require keeping the copyright notice; the release README credits them.
| [OpenXR SDK loader + headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK) | 1.1.63 (release-1.1.63, nupkg) | Apache-2.0 | Talks to the VR runtime (SteamVR). `openxr_loader.dll` ships in `mecvr\` and is loaded by full path |
